title: R2-D2
description: Serving Queen Amidala as far back as the crisis on Naboo and saving her Royal Starship from the Trade Federation blockade, R2-D2 served Padmé and her eventual husband Anakin Skywalker for many years until the end of the Clone Wars. Artoo later kept tabs on Princess Leia, with the galaxy-saving encounter where she embedded the plans to the Death Star in his memory banks, the last hope of the galaxy...
